pages.title: Bridgmanite
pages.text: The most abundant mineral on Earth - and almost never seen, because it only exists under the pressure of the lower mantle.

Made in $(item)Tectonic Press$().$(br2)$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Bridgmanite Ore$(), in veins through the rock.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Deep Borehole chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Metamorphic Petrology.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Pressure Boots, Pressure Chestplate, Pressure Helmet, Pressure Leggings.
